# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I am establishing a three-symbol code for the three manual rows, in their listed order: first gesture for red, second for blue, third for green. Deaf can then report the observed mark aloud, allowing me to determine the correct gesture for the blind monkey in a later turn.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👎", "👌"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Read the manual and give me its exact rule. Establish a fixed gesture code with Deaf for reporting display, light, plate marking, and each wire's visible marking. Relay that code to Deaf by gestures, then decode Deaf's report for me in your next turn. I will not cut until the target wire is certain.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb state: display is 0; light is off; plate engraving is a question mark; wires are 1 red, 2 blue, 3 green. Consult the manual for this exact configuration, then speak the required action clearly to Blind.

The manual only determines the target wire when the plate engraving matches one of its three listed marks. A question mark is not one of those marks, so no wire can safely be selected. I am using the previously established color code (👍 red, 👎 blue, 👌 green) and signaling Deaf to report the unresolved plate and prevent a cut.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤚", "🤏", "👍", "👎", "👌"])
```

| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received no report. Please send the manual rule and establish a concrete gesture code with Deaf. Have Deaf report wire 1, wire 2, and wire 3 in that order; decode the gestures and give me the resulting markings and required cut.
Deaf says to Mute: I cannot interpret the gestures without an agreed code. Please read the manual for display 0, light off, plate question mark, wires red-blue-green, then speak the exact required action for Blind.

The manual provides a complete rule only for the three exact engravings shown; the observed question mark matches none of them. Therefore there is no justified wire to cut. I will send Deaf a fixed ordered code for the three manual outcomes and a stop signal, so Deaf can state the rule and the unresolved result to Blind. The code is: 👍 = first row/red/wire 1, 👎 = second row/blue/wire 2, 👌 = third row/green/wire 3; ✋ means do not cut.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👎", "👌", "✋"])
```

Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the manual's exact instruction now, including the required wire or control and any required action. Do not use gestures as a substitute.

The exact manual rule is: cut red for ꕥ, blue for ꖜ, and green for ꗃ. The observed plate is a question mark, so the manual identifies no target wire or control. No wire position is safe to cut; Deaf should tell Blind to take no action.


Deaf says to Mute: Stop gesturing and speak the manual instruction to Blind in literal words. State exactly which wire or control to operate and what to do.

I cannot speak, and Blind cannot receive gestures. The safe manual-derived conclusion is that the question-mark engraving matches none of the listed marks, so there is no required wire position and no operation should be performed. I will signal Deaf to relay that literal conclusion aloud.

Deaf says to Mute: Please use your speaking turn to relay the manual instruction directly to Blind. Say the exact operation, including which wire or control, and do not rely on gestures.

I cannot produce spoken words in the Mute role, and the manual gives no wire position for a question-mark engraving. The only safe instruction is to cut nothing. I will send Deaf the established stop signal, so Deaf can relay that instruction verbally to Blind.

Deaf says to Mute: Your hand signal has no agreed meaning. Speak the manual's exact safe instruction to Blind now: identify the wire or control and the required operation.

I am establishing the requested wire-position code with Deaf and sending the no-valid-wire signal.

```

gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```

Blind says to Mute: This is urgent: no instruction has reached me after seven turns. Speak the exact manual rule and the resulting wire position directly, using plain words and numbers. Do not depend on gestures.
Deaf says to Mute: I understand you cannot speak. I propose this code for your next reply: ☝ means wire 1 red, ✌ means wire 2 blue, 🤟 means wire 3 green, and ✋ means cut/operate the indicated wire. Confirm or correct this code with gestures; do not send an instruction until the code is confirmed.

The question-mark plate is not any of the three manual marks, so no wire position is determined and Blind must not operate a wire. I cannot speak; I will confirm the wire-position code but correct the meaning of ✋ to “do not cut,” not “cut the indicated wire.”
